# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built. In Chrome it builds the whole list behind the
# game from its first frame; in Firefox those above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a section when
# a frame first asks for 4 of its shaders, the game waiting. So nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated
# graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README). A description in two sections is built with the first.
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing (the page's default settings): bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how)
# runs N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each
# section, and tools/shader_survey.js reaches each place by a warp (web/survey.cpp). Above the first section: the
# launcher, the logos and the title screen waiting for Start. Then the menus: the file select, name entry for a new
# file, Link's house and the pause menu's four pages; the opening cutscene of a new file; and a section a region, each
# place in it entered and run about in for a few seconds, a child where a child goes and an adult in the temples and
# on a second visit to the places that change as he grows (src/game/warp_table.ntsc-1.0.h names them). Not recorded:
# night, most cutscenes, items used, enemies fought, the ending.
# The firetemple section was recorded by a run of its own (--only firetemple), its first having missed Start at the
# title, and put in its place.
